excluded_events.name: FRB 20201124A FAST+uGMRT
excluded_events.reason: Xu+ 2022 is FAST L-band only. Coordinated uGMRT+FAST same-burst detections not confirmed in peer-reviewed literature as of 2026-03.

excluded_events.name: FRB 20180916B CHIME+Apertif
excluded_events.reason: Pastor-Marazuela+ 2021 explicitly shows chromatic sub-period: high-freq (Apertif) and low-freq (CHIME) are active at different sub-phases of the 16.35-day cycle. Not the same burst.

excluded_events.name: SGR 1935+2154 FAST L-band (Li+ 2021)
excluded_events.reason: Li+ 2021 FAST detections are L-band only (1.0-1.5 GHz). No confirmed simultaneous high-frequency counterpart.

excluded_events.name: FRB 20190303A (CHIME repeater)
excluded_events.reason: Multi-frequency detections from different epochs in CHIME band only.
